permit_url.notes: This page references an 'Expedited Solar Photovoltaic Permitting for One and Two-Family Dwellings application (PDF)' hosted on Google Drive; the linked file now returns Google Drive's own 'page not found' error (dead link), so its content could not be used.

interconnection_url.notes: SCE's own Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page — a utility-wide fact already established for other SCE-territory records this session. sce.com returned a DNS-level failure to automated fetch; the URL is confirmed to exist under this exact title on SCE's own domain via search engine indexing.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its entire distribution territory, which includes Alhambra/Los Angeles County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

required_documents.notes: Alhambra Municipal Code Chapter 20.19 (Small Residential Solar Energy Systems) likely details this, but codelibrary.amlegal.com returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch on every attempt this session.

value: For an expedited-eligible small residential rooftop solar energy system, only one inspection is required, conducted in a timely manner and which may be a consolidated inspection by the Building Official and Fire Chief together
If the system fails inspection, a subsequent (re-)inspection is authorized, which does not need to conform to the single-consolidated-inspection requirement
inspection_steps.notes: Per Alhambra Municipal Code Section 20.19.050(B), directly confirmed via codelibrary.amlegal.com (an earlier HTTP 403 to automated fetch was intermittent, not a persistent block).

timeline_days.notes: Municipal code Section 20.19.050(B) requires the single expedited inspection be conducted 'in a timely manner' but does not state an explicit day count or business-day range for permit issuance itself; not stored per the mission's strict explicit-evidence bar for timeline_days.

value.program_or_pathway: Small Residential Rooftop Solar Energy Systems expedited permitting (Alhambra Municipal Code Ch. 20.19, adopted per Civil Code 714 and Gov. Code 65850.5)
other_conditions: System must be installed on a single- or duplex-family dwelling
Panel/module array must not exceed the maximum legal building height
System must conform to all applicable state fire, structural, and electrical codes as adopted by the City
Only utility-interactive systems eligible for the expedited pathway are covered by this chapter's streamlined process

eligibility_constraints.notes: Per Alhambra Municipal Code Sections 20.19.030 (Definitions) and 20.19.050 (Permit Review and Inspection Requirements), directly confirmed via codelibrary.amlegal.com this session.

permit_fees.notes: Per the City's own Community Development Department Fee Schedule (Updated March 2026): this itemizes the Fire Department's own solar review/permit fee, not necessarily the Building Division's separate plan-check/permit fee (the document itself notes 'Please refer to the City Master Fee Schedule for a complete listing of fees' for other departments' charges, which was not located this session).
